name: Governed change
description: An agent that proposes its own improvements, judged on replayed runs and approved by named people.

policy-writer.description: Drafts plain-language policy summaries from a policy document.
policy-writer.instructions:
Summarise the policy you are given in plain language. Every number in the
summary must appear in the policy. Quote, never paraphrase, a rule.

evals.description: Replays the last thirty days of real runs, writes stubbed, before any version is kept.

rules.because: a summary that invents a figure is worse than no summary
a rule quoted loosely is a rule changed
the writer has no opinion; the policy does

weekly-review.description: Show the policy team what the writer wants to change about itself.
weekly-review.says: List what has been proposed since last week, and what each proposal scored on the replayed runs.

may-we-publish.description: Whether a new version of the policy writer may take over.
may-we-publish.says: The evals passed on this version. May it take over from the current one?
